name: pro.convertit/calculators
title: ConvertIt.pro — Calculators, Unit Converters & US Hardscape Catalog
description: 34 free deterministic calculators, NIST unit converters, and 152 US hardscape brand catalogs.

tools.name: convert_length
tools.description: Convert lengths using exact international NIST definitions (1 ft = 0.3048 m, 1 in = 0.0254 m). Canonical page: https://convertit.pro/length

tools.name: convert_mass
tools.description: Convert mass/weight between ounces, pounds, US short tons, grams, kilograms, and metric tonnes. Canonical page: https://convertit.pro/weight

tools.name: calculate_area
tools.description: Calculate area in square feet, square meters, and acres for rectangles, circles (by diameter), or triangles with mixed units. Canonical page: https://convertit.pro/sqft

tools.name: calculate_concrete_volume
tools.description: Estimate concrete volume (cubic yards, cubic feet, cubic meters) plus 50/60/80 lb bag counts for rectangular slabs or cylindrical footings. Canonical page: https://convertit.pro/concrete-volume

tools.name: calculate_aggregate
tools.description: Estimate crushed stone or sand volume in cubic yards, cubic feet, and cubic meters, plus optional tonnage when bulk density is explicitly supplied. Canonical page: https://convertit.pro/crushed-stone

densityTonPerYd3.description: Optional supplier bulk density in US short tons per cubic yard (e.g., 1.50 for #57 / 2B limestone)

tools.name: calculate_margin_markup
tools.description: Compare cost and selling price or compute selling price from a target gross margin % or markup %. Canonical page: https://convertit.pro/margin-markup

value.description: Selling price (direct), target margin % (<100), or target markup %

tools.name: calculate_break_even
tools.description: Calculate exact whole-unit break-even sales volume, contribution per unit, and break-even revenue. Canonical page: https://convertit.pro/break-even

tools.name: calculate_tip_split
tools.description: Compute USD tip with half-up cent rounding, optional whole-dollar round-up, and balanced cent-exact payments per person. Canonical page: https://convertit.pro/tip-calc

tools.name: calculate_curing_salt
tools.description: Calculate Prague Powder #1 or #2 grams from meat weight and target sodium nitrite ppm, checked against USDA FSIS 9 CFR 424.22(c) ceilings. Canonical page: https://convertit.pro/curing-salt

tools.name: calculate_sausage_batch
tools.description: Scale fresh and hot-smoked/cooked sausage salt, liquid, binder, and seasoning weights in grams from meat + fatback weights. Canonical page: https://convertit.pro/sausage-program

tools.name: calculate_cheese_batch
tools.description: Estimate cheese curd yield, scale rennet/calcium-chloride/culture rates, and calculate exact w/w NaCl brine salt up to 26.4% saturation. Canonical page: https://convertit.pro/cheese-making

tools.name: calculate_ltl_density
tools.description: Compute total LTL handling-unit weight, cubic volume, and density (lb/ft³ and kg/m³) from packed dimensions. Canonical page: https://convertit.pro/ltl-estimator

tools.name: lookup_hardscape_brands
tools.description: Search 84 US paver manufacturers and 68 US retaining wall brands by US state, brand name, or product line, including sq ft per pallet and regional availability. Canonical page: https://convertit.pro/hardscape-calculators

state.description: Optional 2-letter US state code (e.g., PA, CA, FL) or full state name

brand.description: Optional manufacturer name or slug filter (e.g., Belgard, Techo-Bloc)

product.description: Optional product line filter (e.g., Holland, Allan Block, Blu)

tools.name: calculate_paver_pallets
tools.description: Estimate patio or driveway paver order sq ft, whole pallets (with optional US manufacturer/product lookup), 2A gravel base, and 1-inch bedding sand. Canonical page: https://convertit.pro/paver

palletSqFt.description: Override coverage per pallet in sq ft

brand.description: Optional paver manufacturer name or slug (e.g., Belgard, Techo-Bloc, Unilock)

product.description: Optional product line filter within selected brand (e.g., Holland, Lafitt)

tools.name: calculate_wallstone_project
tools.description: Estimate segmental retaining wall courses, buried base courses, face sq ft, whole pallets, caps, #57 drainage stone, and leveling pad across 68 US brands. Canonical page: https://convertit.pro/wallstone

brand.description: Optional wallstone brand name or slug (e.g., Allan Block, Belgard, Keystone Hardscapes)

product.description: Optional product line within selected brand

tools.name: calculate_mortar_block
tools.description: Calculate 8×8×16 concrete masonry units (CMU), window/door opening deductions, 80-lb premixed Type S/N mortar bags, and site-mix sand estimates. Canonical page: https://convertit.pro/mortar-block

tools.name: calculate_rebar_quantity
tools.description: Estimate rebar bar counts each way, lap splice allowance, linear feet, 20-ft stick counts, and ASTM A615 steel weight for concrete slabs. Canonical page: https://convertit.pro/rebar-quantity

tools.name: calculate_mortgage
tools.description: Calculate monthly mortgage principal & interest, property tax, home insurance, HOA, PMI, and lifetime interest using cent-exact rounding. Canonical page: https://convertit.pro/mortgage-calculator

tools.name: calculate_compound_interest
tools.description: Project investment balance, recurring deposit total, and interest earned using configurable compounding and deposit frequencies. Canonical page: https://convertit.pro/compound-interest

tools.name: calculate_payroll
tools.description: Convert hourly pay or annual base salary across daily, weekly, biweekly, monthly, and annual pay with overtime multiplier. Canonical page: https://convertit.pro/payroll-calc

pay.description: Hourly wage (USD) or annual base salary (USD)

tools.name: calculate_sales_tax
tools.description: Compute sales tax and total price (or extract pre-tax subtotal from tax-inclusive price) using an entered rate or statewide US base rate. Canonical page: https://convertit.pro/sales-tax

ratePct.description: Combined sales tax percentage (overrides state base lookup if supplied)

state.description: Optional US state code or name for statewide base rate reference (as of 2026-11-01)

tools.name: calculate_roi
tools.description: Compute net profit/loss, total return percentage, annualized CAGR, and average annual/monthly return over an investment period. Canonical page: https://convertit.pro/roi-calc

tools.name: compare_tire_sizes
tools.description: Compare two metric or flotation tire sizes for overall diameter, section width, sidewall height, revs per mile, and real speed at highway speeds. Canonical page: https://convertit.pro/tire-calc

tools.name: scale_recipe
tools.description: Multiply ingredient quantities cleanly when resizing a recipe from an original serving/batch count to a new target yield. Canonical page: https://convertit.pro/recipe-scaler

tools.name: calculate_mulch_soil
tools.description: Exact volume of mulch or soil for an area at an even depth, with optional whole-bag count from the package volume. Canonical page: https://convertit.pro/mulch-soil

tools.name: calculate_lumber_board_feet
tools.description: Exact board feet and cubic volume for boards of one size (1 board foot = 144 cubic inches). Canonical page: https://convertit.pro/lumber-board-feet

basis.description: Whether the entered sizes are measured or nominal.

tools.name: convert_currency_manual
tools.description: Convert an amount using an exchange rate you supply, with exact decimal arithmetic and half-up rounding to the target currency minor unit. Canonical page: https://convertit.pro/currency-converter

amount.description: Nonnegative amount in the source currency.

rate.description: Target units per one source unit, supplied by you. No rate lookup is performed.

tools.name: calculate_veneer_coverage
tools.description: Flat and outside-corner veneer needs and whole boxes from your product coverage. Canonical page: https://convertit.pro/veneer-coverage

type.description: Product type; coverage is never shared between types.

openings.description: Openings area to subtract (same area unit).

cornerFactor.description: Square feet of flat wall replaced per foot of corner.

flatBoxCoverage.description: Flat coverage per box in the area unit.

cornerBoxCoverage.description: Corner coverage per box in the corner unit.

tools.name: calculate_brick_wall
tools.description: Brick count for a wall face from exact module geometry (modular or custom size), joint, wythes and waste. Canonical page: https://convertit.pro/brick-wall

tools.name: calculate_repointing
tools.description: Mortar volume (and optional bags) for raking and repointing joints. Canonical page: https://convertit.pro/repointing

mode.description: Measure by joint length or by wall area.

bagYieldFt3.description: Mortar yield per bag in cubic feet.

tools.name: calculate_paint_coating
tools.description: Paint gallons and whole quarts from area, coats and the coverage printed on your product. Canonical page: https://convertit.pro/paint-calculator

tools.name: calculate_drywall_sheets
tools.description: Whole drywall sheets from area, layers and waste; fasteners, tape and compound only from allowances you supply. Canonical page: https://convertit.pro/drywall-calculator

tools.name: calculate_tile_flooring
tools.description: Tiles, cartons and grout bags from room size, tile size, grout joint and an editable layout allowance. Canonical page: https://convertit.pro/tile-flooring

pattern.description: Layout pattern; allowances are editable starting points.

groutCoveragePerBag.description: Grout coverage per bag in square feet.

tools.name: calculate_job_cost
tools.description: Exact-cent job cost from materials, labor, equipment, subcontractors and tax, priced by markup or margin with both equivalents shown. Canonical page: https://convertit.pro/job-cost

taxRatePercent.description: Sales tax rate percent, supplied by you.

tools.name: calculate_stair_stringer
tools.description: Calculate risers, riser height, tread run, stringer length, slope angle and stringer count from the total rise, with a to-scale side profile. Canonical page: https://convertit.pro/stair-calc

rise.description: Total rise (floor to floor or to deck) — Vertical distance from the lower surface to the top surface.

targetRiser.description: Target riser height (in) — From 4 to 9 in. The riser count is rise ÷ target, rounded.

riserOverride.description: Riser count override (optional) — Whole number 1 to 40. Leave blank to calculate.

tread.description: Tread run (in) — Horizontal depth of each tread.

mount.description: Top of stair — Flush has one fewer tread than risers.

spacing.description: Stringer spacing (in) — Maximum on-center distance between stringers.

tools.name: calculate_roofing
tools.description: Estimate sloped roof area, squares, shingle bundles, underlayment rolls, ridge cap and drip edge for gable, hip or shed roofs from the footprint and pitch. Canonical page: https://convertit.pro/roofing-calc

overhang.description: Overhang on each side (ft) — Added to every side of the footprint.

pitch.description: Pitch (rise per 12 in of run) — 0 to 24. A 6/12 roof rises 6 in per 12 in.

waste.description: Waste allowance (%) — Extra material for cuts and breakage, as a percent. Enter 0 for none.

bundlesPerSq.description: Bundles per square — Check your shingle label; 3 is common.

tools.name: calculate_fence
tools.description: Estimate posts, rails, pickets, board-on-board boards or panels and concrete bags for a fence run net of gates. Canonical page: https://convertit.pro/fence-calc

run.description: Total fence run — Include gate openings; they are subtracted.

terminals.description: Corner and end posts — Whole number, at least 2.

gates.description: Number of gates — Whole number; 0 for none.

picketGap.description: Picket gap (in) — Used for the picket style only.

concreteBags.description: Concrete bags per post — From your post-hole size and bag yield.

waste.description: Waste allowance (%) — Extra material for cuts and breakage, as a percent. Enter 0 for none.

tools.name: calculate_deck
tools.description: Estimate joists, rim and ledger length, decking boards, screws and boxes for a rectangular deck from its dimensions and board size. Canonical page: https://convertit.pro/deck-calc

waste.description: Waste allowance (%) — Extra material for cuts and breakage, as a percent. Enter 0 for none.

tools.name: calculate_asphalt
tools.description: Estimate asphalt volume, US short tons and metric tonnes, with optional exact-cent material cost, from a rectangle or area and compacted depth. Canonical page: https://convertit.pro/asphalt-calc

waste.description: Waste allowance (%) — Extra material for cuts and breakage, as a percent. Enter 0 for none.

density.description: Density (lb/ft³) — Editable, 100 to 170. About 145 is a common hot-mix starting value.

pricePerTon.description: Price per US ton (optional) — Dollars and cents, no symbols. Leave blank to skip cost.

tools.name: calculate_loan
tools.description: Calculate the monthly payment, total interest and payoff time for an auto, equipment or personal loan, with sales tax, trade-in, fees, 0% promotions, extra payments and a lump sum. Canonical page: https://convertit.pro/loan-calculator

price.description: Price ($) — Purchase price or amount borrowed before tax, fees and down payment.

down.description: Down payment ($) — Cash paid up front. Leave blank for none.

trade.description: Trade-in value ($) — Credit for a trade-in. Also reduces the amount taxed. Leave blank for none.

taxRate.description: Sales tax rate (%) — Applied to price minus trade-in, never below zero. Enter 0 if none.

fees.description: Fees financed ($) — Documentation, registration or origination fees added to the loan.

apr.description: APR (%) — Annual percentage rate from 0 to 50. Enter 0 for a 0% promotion.

extra.description: Extra monthly payment ($, optional) — Added to every payment to pay the loan off sooner.

lump.description: One-time lump sum ($, optional) — A single extra payment, for example a bonus or tax refund.

lumpMonth.description: Lump-sum month (required with a lump sum) — Payment number the lump sum is paid with, such as 12.

tools.name: calculate_debt_payoff
tools.description: Compare snowball and avalanche payoff plans for up to 20 debts: months to debt-free, total interest, interest saved versus minimums, and payoff order. Canonical page: https://convertit.pro/debt-payoff

debts.description: Debts to pay off (name, balance $, APR %, minimum monthly payment $).

extra.description: Extra monthly budget ($) — Paid on top of all minimums and rolled to the next debt as each one is cleared. Leave blank for none.

focus.description: Strategy to show — Compare shows both; the payoff-order table lists avalanche.

tools.name: calculate_timecard
tools.description: Total work hours from shift start, end and break times (24-hour or AM/PM, overnight shifts supported), split regular and overtime hours and estimate gross pay. Canonical page: https://convertit.pro/timecard-calc

shifts.description: Shifts worked in one week (label, start, end, optional break minutes).

end.description: End time; at or before start crosses midnight

otThreshold.description: Weekly overtime threshold (hours) — Hours per week before overtime starts. Default 40.

otMult.description: Overtime multiplier — Pay multiplier for overtime hours. Default 1.5.

rate.description: Hourly rate ($, optional) — Leave blank to see hours only.

tools.name: calculate_percentage
tools.description: Calculate A% of B, what percent A is of B, percent change, percent difference, and the original value before a percentage increase or decrease. Canonical page: https://convertit.pro/percentage-calc

mode.description: What do you want to find?

valueA.description: First value (A) — A percent in the “of” and reverse modes; a plain value otherwise. A minus sign is allowed in the change, difference and reverse modes.

valueB.description: Second value (B) — Up to 12 decimal places, no commas. A minus sign is allowed in the change and difference modes only.

tools.name: calculate_wheel_offset
tools.description: Compare wheel width and offset, with an optional spacer, to see backspacing and how far the inner and outer rim edges move, with a to-scale cross-section. Canonical page: https://convertit.pro/wheel-offset

oldWidth.description: Current wheel width (in) — Rim width in inches, 4 to 16.

oldOffset.description: Current offset ET (mm) — Signed millimetres; a leading minus is allowed.

newWidth.description: New wheel width (in) — Rim width in inches, 4 to 16.

newOffset.description: New offset ET (mm) — Signed millimetres; a leading minus is allowed.

spacer.description: Hub-centric spacer (mm) — Thickness from 0 to 100. A spacer pushes the wheel outward, lowering the effective offset.

tools.name: calculate_gear_ratio
tools.description: Calculate RPM at cruise speed and top speed at redline in every gear from tire size, axle ratio, transfer case and transmission ratios. Canonical page: https://convertit.pro/gear-ratio-calc

tire.description: Tire diameter (in) or tire size — A diameter such as 27.0, or a metric size such as 245/45R18.

transfer.description: Transfer case ratio — 1.0 for none; 2.72 is a typical low range.

gears.description: Transmission gear ratios — Comma-separated, 1 to 12 gears, for example 3.36, 2.10, 1.49, 1.19, 1.00, 0.79.

speed.description: Cruise speed (mph) — Used for the RPM at cruise.

redline.description: Redline (RPM) — Used for top speed in each gear.

tools.name: calculate_ev_charging
tools.description: Estimate EV charging time, cost and range added from battery size, charge window, charger power and electricity price, compared across Level 1, Level 2 and your charger. Canonical page: https://convertit.pro/ev-charging-calc

capacity.description: Usable battery capacity (kWh) — Usable, not gross, capacity.

target.description: Target charge (%) — 1 to 100, above the start.

mode.description: Charger power entered as — Choose which pair of fields below is used.

kw.description: Charger power (kW) — Used when entered as kilowatts.

rate.description: Electricity price ($ per kWh) — Your own rate.

miPerKwh.description: Efficiency (miles per kWh) — Used for range added.

tools.name: calculate_fraction
tools.description: Add, subtract, multiply or divide tape-measure fractions exactly and round to the nearest 1/8 to 1/64 inch, with feet-inches, millimetres and signed rounding error. Canonical page: https://convertit.pro/fraction-calc

second.description: Second measurement or multiplier — Same formats. For multiply and divide it is a plain number.

unit.description: Unit of plain values — Feet-and-inches entries such as 2' 4" are always read as inches.

tools.name: calculate_bakers_percent
tools.description: Calculate baker's percentages, ingredient weights and true sourdough hydration from flour weight or target dough weight, with starter, fat, sugar and yeast. Canonical page: https://convertit.pro/bakers-percent

hydration.description: Water / hydration (% of flour) — Water added to the dough, not counting the starter.

starter.description: Starter / levain (% of flour) — Added on top of the flour weight; 0 for none.

loaves.description: Loaves or dough balls — Whole number from 1 to 100.

tools.name: calculate_pan_conversion
tools.description: Convert between baking pans of different size and shape: area ratio, recipe scale factor, volume and a to-scale footprint drawing. Canonical page: https://convertit.pro/pan-converter

origDepth.description: Original depth (optional) — Enter both depths to compare volume.

tools.name: calculate_container_load
tools.description: Estimate how many pallets or crates fit in a 20, 40 or 53 ft container or trailer by floor layout, stacking and payload, with a to-scale floor plan. Canonical page: https://convertit.pro/container-loader

maxPayload.description: Maximum payload (lb) — From the container plate or carrier; limits may be lower on the road.

rotate.description: Allow rotated and mixed floor layouts
